title: Chroma Clash
one_line: A funky 3D color-matching card game: play bots, friends on one phone, or friends anywhere online.
how_to_play: Tap a glowing card that matches the top card's color, number or symbol. No match? Tap the deck to draw. Hit LAST CARD! when you are down to one.
description: Match the top card by color, number or symbol and be the first to empty your hand. Freeze skips the next player, Flip reverses the turn order, +2 makes them draw, and Prism cards let you pick the new color (Prism +4 hits them with four more). Stack draw cards to pile the pain onto the next player, and don't forget to shout LAST CARD! in time. Play against cheeky bots, pass one phone around with friends, or open an online room and share the code so friends anywhere can join. Up to 6 players, neon table, disco floor and a funky soundtrack.
